en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style view of a European city street with tram tracks, pedestrians, horse-drawn vehicles, and ornate multi‑story stone buildings on both sides. In the foreground is a canal with a small arched bridge and moored boats. The scene looks like an early 20th‑century urban streetscape. Printed text at the top right reads "Göteborg, Västra Hamngatan."
